title: Former Associate Vice President at Marvell Technology Sees Strategic Value in Lumentum Deal Despite Transaction Risks
expert: Former Associate Vice President at Marvell (now at AMD); custom devices and M&A integration
verdict: A former Marvell AVP backs the Lumentum deal as the copper-to-fiber move for 2030 but says the all-stock 4.5 MRVL shares per LITE share is dilutive and will not fix supply, with Lumentum sold out through early 2029 (hearsay).

Greenfield legs: TIAs and DSPs plus Lumentum optics for a 2030 copper-to-fiber shift (estimate), a one-stop shop for hyperscalers. → Tenet 3 (scale-up optics) ↑
Margins: 4.5 shares per Lumentum share, all-stock, matches deal terms (SB #65699); value falls with MRVL stock and invites a rival bid. → Tenet 5 (bear flank) ↑
Interconnect growth rate: Coherent may move away from Marvell, but that business volume is "not large" (first read). → Tenet 2 (1.6T duopoly) →

characterization_changed: Characterization changed from Positive: the expert's only Marvell figures are the dilutive 4.5-share all-stock ratio and a supply sell-out the deal does not fix; the upside is strategic opinion.
changes: Lumentum sold out through early 2029 and "only able to meet about 70%" of demand next year (hearsay) vs the 2026-11-05 Lightmatter and Semtech calls, which said Lumentum is unable to meet ~70% of demand: conflicting on the 70% (met vs unmet); same early-2029 sell-out.
Exchange ratio 4.5 shares, over $1,000 per LITE share at announcement (expert) vs 4.500 MRVL shares per LITE share, ~$1,132/share (SB #65699): consistent.
Executive retention two or three years post-close (estimate) vs Lightmatter 2026-11-05 integration one or two years: consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 3 (scale-up optics greenfield): ↑ — combining Marvell TIAs/DSPs with Lumentum optics for the 2030 copper-to-fiber shift.
Tenet 2 (1.6T duopoly): → — Coherent may diversify away, but its Marvell volume is not large.
Tenet 5 (bear flank): ↑ — 4.5-share all-stock ratio is dilutive and exposes the deal to a competing bid if MRVL falls.
